hover.$description: Raised inset Gem control rim for Hover.

blur.$description: Backdrop blur candidate for transparent Gem controls.

stabilizedFace.$description: Quiet Light Gem stabilized content plane.

innerSeparation.$description: Separation before a stabilized inner tile.

none.$description: Flush adjoining items with no additional separation.
